verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents itself as a PWA that can be added to a phone home screen, desktop taskbar, or dock, and the same interface exposes rich features (RAG, memory, voice, image generation, MCP) beyond basic chat — but there is no evidence of a distinct native desktop or mobile app (e.g., app-store listings, Electron/native binaries) with parity; a community comment even flags the Docker-based self-hosted setup as a portability hurdle. Missing for 10: dedicated native desktop/mobile app evidence, app-store presence, or confirmation that the PWA truly matches native app UX beyond installability.
